'''2 ABY''' was the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

==Events==
*Construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] began.<ref name="TNEC" />
*37:3:1&mdash;A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] group fortified in a warehouse complex in [[Camaa]], [[Fremond III]] surrenders to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, ending a three-day long siege.<ref name="J9">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*37:3:14&mdash;In a formal open ceremony held in the [[Skydome Botanical Gardens/Legends|Skydome Botanical Gardens]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rufaan Tigellinus]] is inducted into the [[Order of the Canted Circle]].<ref name="J9" />
*37:3:21&mdash;Due to sabotage arranged in response to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Norrin]]'s increased efforts to prosecute certain less legitimate [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] guilds, an explosion from the port-most [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'' occurs and strikes the [[Wroona Stardock]].<ref name="J9" />
*37:4&mdash;The Galactic Empire and the [[Kessel Mining Authority]] launched an operation against illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Over 50 squatter mines were shut down and 30 [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were arrested.<ref name="GNN10">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*37:4:19&mdash;Rawmat [[Rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY|shortage]] led to the refurbishment of 100 ''Victory''-class Star Destroyers with red [[Havod/Legends|havod]]-alloy plates.<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:4&mdash;[[Spaaga Core, Inc.]] acquired the mining rights to a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] and entered into the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas market.<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:5&mdash;[[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archeologists]] discovered prehistoric art in a [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] cave that prophesied the [[Declaration of a New Order|Rise of the Emperor]].<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:5:24&mdash;Opening of the [[Rapora Mining]] facility on [[Little Capella]].<ref name="GNN10" />
*Disappearance of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:6:26&mdash;The banishment of the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]] from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] is announced in a press release from [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] [[Tanna Odann]].<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:6:30&mdash;[[Slungerhound]]s were banned from the [[Corulus system|Corula system]].<ref name="GNN10" />
*37:8&mdash;[[Jatz/Legends|Jatz]] musician [[Fitz Roi]] began his new tour on [[Gambolla]].<ref name="GNN11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*37:9:2&mdash;The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Calabar Queen]]'' was destroyed on its way to [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]] by the [[Justice Action Network]].<ref name="GNN11" />
*37:9&mdash;Grand Admiral Thrawn returned to the known galaxy.<ref name="GNN11" />
*37:9&mdash;Thief [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]] sacked [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Galrowk]]'s famed art collection on Gambolla.<ref name="GNN11" />
*Spreading of the [[Pinacism]] movement through [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="GNN12">{{JournalCite|12|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*37:10:23&mdash;The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was unveiled to the public and officially commissioned at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Imperial Transfer Post]],<ref name="GNN12" /> despite having been in active [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] service for [[0 ABY/Legends|two years]].<ref name="TNEC" />
*37:11:13&mdash;Grand Admiral Thrawn was inducted into the Order of the Canted Circle.<ref name="GNN12" />
*37:11:26&mdash;[[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] was banned from the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]].<ref name="GNN12" />
*Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was "[[Empire of the Hand|exiled]]" in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dagon Niriz|Niriz]] and the ''[[Admonitor]]'' were assigned to Thrawn's mapping expedition.<ref name="CD">{{JournalCite|11|Command Decision}}</ref>
*Thrawn defeated [[Creysis]]'s pirates.<ref name="CD" />
*[[Capture of Zekka Thyne|Capture]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Zekka Thyne]] by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]] and [[Hal Horn]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], through a plan conceived by Grand Admiral Thrawn.<ref name="ST">"[[Side Trip]]"/[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|''13'']]</ref>
*The Rebel [[Cataalda outpost|outpost]] on [[Cataalda]] was abandoned.<ref name="PL&tRR">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom]]''</ref>
